description: This file implements a sensor shell interface for Zephyr OS, providing commands to get sensor data, set/get attributes, manage triggers, and retrieve sensor info. It includes definitions for sensor channels, attributes, trigger handling, and command registration.

methods.name: find_sensor_trigger_device
methods.description: Finds the index of a sensor device in the trigger device array.

methods.name: sensor_trigger_name_lookup
methods.description: Looks up trigger index by trigger name string.

methods.name: parse_named_int
methods.description: Parses a string as an integer or looks up its index in a name list.

methods.name: parse_sensor_value
methods.description: Parses a string into a sensor_value structure.

methods.name: sensor_shell_processing_callback
methods.description: Callback to process sensor data, handle triggers, and output info.

methods.name: cmd_get_sensor
methods.description: Handles 'get' command to read sensor data.

methods.name: cmd_sensor_attr_set
methods.description: Handles 'attr_set' command to set sensor attributes.

methods.name: cmd_sensor_attr_get
methods.description: Handles 'attr_get' command to retrieve sensor attributes.

methods.name: channel_name_get
methods.description: Provides dynamic command subentries for sensor channels.

methods.name: attribute_name_get
methods.description: Provides dynamic command subentries for sensor attributes.

methods.name: trigger_opt_get_for_stream
methods.description: Provides options for trigger data handling in stream.

methods.name: trigger_name_get_for_stream
methods.description: Provides trigger name options for stream.

methods.name: stream_on_off
methods.description: Provides 'on'/'off' options for stream commands.

methods.name: device_name_get
methods.description: Provides device name options for commands.

methods.name: device_name_get_for_attr
methods.description: Provides device name options for attribute commands.

methods.name: trigger_name_get
methods.description: Provides trigger name options.

methods.name: trigger_on_off_get
methods.description: Provides 'on'/'off' options for trigger commands.

methods.name: device_name_get_for_trigger
methods.description: Provides device name options for trigger commands.

methods.name: device_name_get_for_stream
methods.description: Provides device name options for stream commands.

methods.name: cmd_get_sensor_info
methods.description: Outputs information about all sensors if available.

methods.name: data_ready_trigger_handler
methods.description: Handles data ready trigger events, fetches data, and logs summaries.

methods.name: cmd_trig_sensor
methods.description: Handles trigger commands to enable/disable triggers on sensors.
